newsitem.title: USA: U of Michigan consumer sentiment Dec prelim 98.9.
newsitem.headline: U of Michigan consumer sentiment Dec prelim 98.9.

text.p: The University of Michigan's preliminary index of consumer sentiment for December fell to 98.9 compared with 99.2 in the final November index, financial market sources said on Friday.
The current conditions component fell to 107.1 in the December final report against the 107.5 reading in the final November.
The expectations index fell to 93.7 in the preliminary December data versus the 93.9 in the final November, the sources added.
The data are released only to paying subscribers.
